# Code review

Read [agents.md](../../../agents.md) and matching `.github/instructions/` rules. For substantive activity-platform changes use [adversarial-audit](../../../.agents/skills/adversarial-audit/SKILL.md); tiny copy/style edits may use quick human review. The canonical files own review requirements and evidence format; this adapter adds no separate review gate.
